description: List the page reports this account has generated, newest first. Each entry has the report ID, URL, overall score, status and creation time. Use it to find a report ID for get_report or get_findings, or to see which pages were already scanned before spending a credit on analyze_website. Filter by URL or status; results come in pages of up to 100, so check the page count at the top of the output and request the next page for more. Read-only. Free: does not use a credit. Returns 'No reports found.' when nothing matches.

status.description: Only reports with this status: 'complete', 'processing', 'queued' or 'failed'. Omit for all.

url.description: Only reports whose URL contains this text, for example 'example.com/pricing'. Omit for all.

name: list_reports
title: List reports
